absolute_run_floor.evidence: ia-independence-of-the-activity-audited-4-6 (ISMS-IA) carries a SINGLE CONTIGUOUS 17-WORD RUN of ISO 19011:2026 cl.4.6 - 'auditors should be independent of the activity being audited wherever practicable and should in all cases act' - at coverage 0.548, and DOES NOT FIRE.
absolute_run_floor.cause: The concept-scale rule is a CONJUNCTION: run >= 4 AND coverage >= 0.60. Coverage is a ratio, so a longer description dilutes a reproduction until it vanishes. Four more words of our own around a verbatim ISO sentence makes it invisible. The lesson-scale gate had a 10-word ABSOLUTE threshold; the concept-scale gate replaced it and removed the floor.
absolute_run_floor.ruling: Fire on (run >= 4 AND coverage >= 0.60) OR (run >= 10). The 10 is not a new number - it is the lesson-scale threshold, and a long description sits at lesson scale.
absolute_run_floor.required: Measure the corpus impact and report per certification. Annex-A-structure rows are expected to need the title-class exemption widened rather than rewriting; report those separately.
